verdict.rationale: SendGrid offers Event Webhooks and Inbound Parse webhooks that can notify external systems on email events (delivered, bounced, opened, incoming mail), which could be used to trigger downstream automation, but there is no evidence of a native rules engine, conditional logic, or built-in 'if event then action' automation within SendGrid itself. missing for 10: no evidence of an in-product rules/automation builder, no conditional trigger-action configuration UI, no AI-native event orchestration or built-in workflow automation beyond raw webhook delivery.
